say:1:1721911001:1.text: Good day to you both. I've come on my master's behalf.
say:1:1721911001:1.source_cn: 两位阁下，日安。我是奉我家主人之命前来的。

say:2:1721911002:1.text: Your master? I don't believe we've met...
say:2:1721911002:1.source_cn: 你家主人？我想我们并不认识……

say:3:1721911003:1.text: No, but my master has already heard about you. A crow returned to the manor a short while ago with word that someone was asking after Lady Silvie.
say:3:1721911003:1.source_cn: 但我家主人已经听说了你们的事。刚才乌鸦飞回府邸报信，这...

say:4:1721911004:1.text: To be frank, Lady Silvie is currently staying as an honored guest in my master's residence.
say:4:1721911004:1.source_cn: 实不相瞒，茜茜夫人正是我家主人的座上宾，近日正暂居主人...

choice_prompt:5:1721911004.text: To be frank, Lady Silvie is currently staying as an honored guest in my master's residence.
choice_prompt:5:1721911004.source_cn: 实不相瞒，茜茜夫人正是我家主人的座上宾，近日正暂居主人府上做客。

say:6:1721911005:1.text: That is precisely why I'm here, but hear me out first.
say:6:1721911005:1.source_cn: 两位请稍安勿躁，我正是为此而来的。

say:7:1721911006:1.text: Lady Silvie is not in the habit of receiving strangers. Still... if you were to call on her properly, with a gift and the right courtesy, she might be willing to make an exception.
say:7:1721911006:1.source_cn: 茜茜夫人身份尊贵，平日里不见生人。不过……如果二位能备...

say:8:1721911007:1.text: A gift? Of course, of course. Naturally. But... what sort of gift would she like? Jewelry? Silk? Antiques?
say:8:1721911007:1.source_cn: 礼物？当然！这是应该的！可是……茜茜夫人喜欢什么样的礼...

say:9:1721911008:1.text: ... Right. For a moment I forgot my own circumstances. There's no way I could afford anything that extravagant...
say:9:1721911008:1.source_cn: ……我又忘记了，以我目前的经济状况，要怎么负担昂贵的礼物……

say:10:1721911009:1.text: That won't be necessary. Lady Silvie has seen more fine jewels and precious ornaments than most people see in a lifetime. These days, it's the smaller, more unusual things that tend to catch her eye.
say:10:1721911009:1.source_cn: 倒也不必如此破费。茜茜夫人已经见惯了华贵的珠宝器物，反...

say:11:1721911010:1.text: Lately, she's developed a fondness for a rather... specific sort of handmade item. If you can find <style="highlight">a long, slender twig</style> and fasten <style="highlight">a soft feather</style> securely to the tip... I'm quite sure it would please her.
say:11:1721911010:1.source_cn: 她近来颇为中意一种……特殊的手工艺品。如果您能找来一些...

choice_prompt:12:1721911010.text: Lately, she's developed a fondness for a rather... specific sort of handmade item. If you can find <style="highlight">a long, slender twig</style> and fasten <style="highlight">a soft feather</style> securely to the tip... I'm quite sure it would please her.
choice_prompt:12:1721911010.source_cn: 她近来颇为中意一种……特殊的手工艺品。如果您能找来一些<style=highlight>细长的树枝</style>，再把<style=highlight>柔软的翎羽</style>牢牢地绑在顶端……这种器具，她一定会喜欢的。

say:13:1721911011:1.text: Ah, I see! A rustic little decoration, then. Of course, we'll prepare one right away!
say:13:1721911011:1.source_cn: 原来如此！一定是某种充满自然野趣的装饰品！我明白了！我...

choice:12:0:1.text: A twig with a feather... that sounds like...
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 树枝加羽毛……这听起来怎么像……
choice:12:0:1.male: A twig with a feather... that sounds like...
choice:12:0:1.female: A twig with a feather... that sounds like...

choice:5:1:2.text: Please take us to Lady Silvie.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 请带我们去见茜茜夫人
choice:5:1:2.male: Please take us to Lady Silvie.
choice:5:1:2.female: Please take us to Lady Silvie.
